main_measure.name: mean excess 5-bar forward return of cases with forecast > 0 (minus coin's normal 5-bar drift)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; fewer than 30 independent cases is inconclusive/not observable

supporting_check.name: mean excess return of larger-forecast half minus smaller-forecast half

decided_by: t lies between -2 and 2 (or could not be computed).
reading: Situation is taken as regime == 'mean_reversion' (the detector's recorded decision for NMR(30) <= 0.3) and raw below_mid value < 0 (close below the 30-bar midpoint), long side; the forecast halves split the cases sorted by forecast into the top and bottom floor(n/2), dropping the middle case when n is odd; normal drift is the mean of the coin's non-overlapping 5-bar grid returns over all its windows.
